title: No-Code AI Virtual Agent for Email Triage and Scheduling
oneLiner: Lindy allows users to create custom, no-code AI virtual agents ("Lindies") that automate multi-step business workflows like email triage, lead enrichment, and meeting scheduling.
evidenceDetail: The linked source describes this workflow and its claimed results. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Lindy allows users to create custom, no-code AI virtual agents ("Lindies") that automate multi-step business workflows like email triage, lead enrichment, and meeting scheduling.
requirements: connected email/calendar APIs (e.g., Gmail, Google Calendar)
steps: Create a new "Lindy" in the dashboard
Define its goal (e.g., "Schedule meetings from inbound emails")
Activate and monitor the agent's actions.
configSnippet: "When an email contains a meeting request, check my calendar availability, draft a reply with 3 time slots, and wait for my approval before sending."
limitations: No-code abstraction limits highly customized, complex logical branching compared to code-first frameworks like LangGraph.

source.title: Lindy — No-Code AI Employees & Workflow Agents
